name: Perplexity
tagline: AI answer engine with cited sources
description: Perplexity is an AI answer engine that searches the web and shows the sources behind an answer, so you can open and check them.
features: Deep Research and model selection per query (Pro)
Image generation and limited video generation
useCases: Quick research where you want sources
Getting oriented on an unfamiliar topic
Finding pages to read in full
strengths: Paid Pro tier adds extended Pro Search and file uploads
limitations: A summary can still misread a source, so open the links for anything important

free.details: Search with citations in every answer and access to basic AI models, with limited usage (the plan card says daily, the FAQ says weekly).

profile.headline: An AI search engine that answers with sources you can open

capabilities.title: Get a direct answer with citations
capabilities.text: Ask a question and Perplexity searches the web, then writes a conversational answer with links to the original sources so you can check it.

capabilities.title: Go deeper on complex questions
capabilities.text: Pro Search is applied automatically for multi-step reasoning and detailed research, and Research mode combines models to produce longer reports.

capabilities.title: Choose the model behind the answer
capabilities.text: Best mode picks a model for you, and paid plans let you choose from a list of advanced models from different providers.

capabilities.title: Ask about your own files
capabilities.text: Upload PDFs, CSVs, audio, video and images and explore their contents in the same conversation.

featureCards.name: Search with citations
featureCards.text: Every answer carries links to the pages it drew from.

featureCards.name: Research mode
featureCards.text: Autonomous, multi-step analysis that returns a comprehensive report on a complex topic.

featureCards.name: Create files and apps
featureCards.text: Builds reports, spreadsheets, dashboards and simple web applications on your behalf.

featureCards.name: Image and video generation
featureCards.text: Generate images and videos from a prompt on paid plans, with video limited on Pro.

featureCards.name: Projects
featureCards.text: Keep related files and conversations together, with team collaboration on Enterprise plans.

featureCards.name: Comet
featureCards.text: Perplexity's own browser, covered in its own section of the Help Center.

audienceDetail.text: Cited answers and Research mode suit anyone gathering information on an unfamiliar topic, and an Education Pro plan is offered to verified students and educators.
Pro adds file analysis, extra uploads and the Create files and apps tool for day-to-day work.
Enterprise Pro and Enterprise Max add admin controls, shared Projects and stricter data privacy.
A separate API Platform provides web-grounded answers and search results for your own products.

scenarios.title: Get oriented on a new topic
scenarios.text: Ask a plain question and follow the citations to the sources worth reading in full.

scenarios.title: Produce a researched report
scenarios.text: Switch to Research mode for a longer write-up that pulls from many pages.

scenarios.title: Analyse a document or spreadsheet
scenarios.text: Upload a file and ask questions about what it contains.

scenarios.title: Turn research into a deliverable
scenarios.text: Use Create files and apps to produce a spreadsheet, dashboard or presentation from your findings.

gettingStarted.text: Type it into the search box on perplexity.ai; no setup is needed to begin.
Click the citations to confirm that a summary read each page correctly.
Use the search box to move between Best, Research and model choices within a session.
The Help Center article on choosing a plan sets out Standard, Pro, Max, Education Pro and Enterprise.
